claim.quote: We find that the significance of the extracted dark matter signal remains well below evidentiary at 1.7 $\sigma$.

name: Maximum Likelihood Signal Extraction Method Applied to 3.4 years of CoGeNT Data

significance.quote: We find that the significance of the extracted dark matter signal remains well below evidentiary at 1.7 $\sigma$.

summary.plain: A statistical re-analysis of 3.4 years of CoGeNT data found a best-fit dark matter signal close to earlier reports but at only 1.7 sigma, well below the level that counts as evidence.
summary.technical: Maximum-likelihood extraction in energy, time and pulse rise-time (1136 live days to 23 April 2013) for a standard-halo case and for free oscillation parameters; best-fit signal close to earlier results; significance 1.7 sigma.

title: Maximum Likelihood Signal Extraction Method Applied to 3.4 years of CoGeNT Data
why_it_matters: The collaboration's own statement that its signal is not statistically significant evidence.
